build_decoder_block: build a DecoderBlock with upsampling conv transpose and residual units for audio decoding
build_decoder: build a Decoder module with multi-stage upsampling blocks to reconstruct audio from latent codes
build_activate_decoder: build an ActivateDecoder with ELU activations between blocks and Tanh output for audio reconstruction
run_decoder_forward: run the Decoder forward pass to transform latent codes into reconstructed audio waveforms
run_decoder_inference: run the Decoder decode method for streaming inference with causal convolutions on latent codes
